heretic.desc: Level 30 PassiveDirect healing done now applies Void-Touched.Void-Touched (Stacks)Marks the ally for 30 seconds, stacking 10 times.When you cast Gaze of C'Thun, all stacks are consumed to heal all allies affected by Void-Touched for healing, increased based on how many stacks were on them.

heretic.name: Visions of the Empire
heretic.desc: Increases the damage converted into healing through Abyssal Covenant by 10%.

heretic.name: Dark Matter
heretic.desc: Channeling Satiate now heals all allies within 30 yds for healing every 1 sec for 10 seconds.

heretic.name: Eldritch Eye
heretic.desc: Invoke the Old Gods for 15 seconds, removing the cast time of your next 3 Eldritch Mendings or Malevolences and causing them to critically strike.

heretic.name: Dark Veil
heretic.desc: Channel a shield of void energies upon an ally, causing both you and them to absorb healing 25% AP damage, stacking 5 times, every 1 sec for 5 seconds.At the end of the duration, the shield holds, you teleport to them.While channeling you are immune to stuns and silences.

heretic.name: Dark Chants
heretic.desc: Reduces the cast time of Forbidden Ritual by 1 sec and allows Black Blood to stack up to 2 times.

heretic.name: Void Barrier
heretic.desc: Casting Herald of the Depths now increases the absorption of your next Void Shield within 10 seconds by 100%.

heretic.name: Dark Infusion
heretic.desc: 3 Charges, 30 sec rechargeInfuse an ally with dark energy, healing them for 44 the next time they take damage. When the heal occurs, Dark Infusion is consumed and expands to the two lowest-health nearby party or raid members. Each secondary infusion heals when triggered, then expands to three nearby allies.

heretic.name: Shadow Pennant
heretic.desc: You now heal the lowest health ally affected by Black Blood for 50% of your auto attack damage. (up to 2 ranks)

heretic.name: Blessing of Yogg-Saron
heretic.desc: While Herald of the Depths is active, you now transform into a Faceless Monstrosity, increasing your critical healing and critical strike chance by 20%, but reducing its duration by -5 sec.In addition, while active you are now immune to fear, horrify, and polymorph effects.

heretic.name: Ancient Rituals
heretic.desc: Casting Satiate now refreshes the duration of Black Blood on all allies within 30 yds.Dark Infusion bounces one additional time after its third infusion, expanding to the three lowest-health nearby party or raid members.

heretic.name: Malevolence
heretic.desc: Generates 10 InsanitySmash an enemy with eldritch force, dealing SP Shadow damage and applying Black Blood to 5 nearby allies, healing them for AP, repeating every 3 sec for 15 seconds.Usable while moving.

heretic.name: Malevolent Power
heretic.desc: Every 3rd melee ability you cast now causes your next Eldritch Mending to become instant cast and cost -20% less mana.

heretic.name: Horrific Revelations
heretic.desc: Every 1 sec while Hand of Yogg-Saron is active, you now trigger a Horrific Revelation on the target and generate 5 Insanity.Horrific RevelationHeals a friendly target for SP, scaling with Insanity, and increases their critical strike chance by 1%, stacking 15 times, for 15 seconds.

heretic.name: Hand of Yogg-Saron
heretic.desc: Tether yourself to an ally for 15 seconds, increasing all damage they deal and reducing all damage they take by 15%.

heretic.name: Prophetic Compulsion
heretic.desc: While Black Blood is active on an ally, healing done to them by your Gaze of C'Thun has a 15% increased chance to critically strike.

heretic.name: Saronite Mind
heretic.desc: Your Eldritch Eye now has 1 additional charge. (up to 2 ranks)

heretic.name: Blade of Yogg-Saron
heretic.desc: Damage dealt by Blade of the Empire now heals the lowest health ally for 35% of the damage dealt plus healing 5% AP. (up to 2 ranks)

heretic.name: Forbidden Ritual
heretic.desc: Chant a forbidden ritual that places a shield on all nearby allies that absorbs healing damage for 10 seconds.

heretic.name: Dark Protection
heretic.desc: Allies affected by Abyssal Covenant now also take 20% increased healing from you.

heretic.name: Lead the Covenant
heretic.desc: 50% of all healing done to allies through Abyssal Covenant is now replicated to you.

heretic.name: Protection From Light
heretic.desc: Reduces all damage taken by party and raid members by -3%.In addition, your Holy damage taken is reduced by -10%.

heretic.name: Dark Rites
heretic.desc: While Herald of the Depths is active, your movement speed cannot be reduced below 100% of normal value.

heretic.name: Saronite Cube
heretic.desc: Melee ability damage now reduces the duration of Wracked Mind by -1 sec on all allies within 30 yds.

heretic.name: Devour Curse
heretic.desc: Devour dark magic on an ally, dispelling 2 curse effects from them and healing you for SP.

heretic.name: Corrupt Fate
heretic.desc: Reduces the cooldown of Dark Veil by -60 sec.

heretic.name: Tales of Woe
heretic.desc: Your Dark Veil now performs its effect -50% faster.

heretic.name: Forbidden Strength
heretic.desc: While Herald of the Depths is active, the critical strike chance of Blade of the Empire is increased by 10%.

heretic.name: Forbidden Resilience
heretic.desc: While Herald of the Depths is active, you now take -15% less damage and have a 25% increased chance to resist dispel effects.
